tours.name: Offboard an Employee
tours.description: Learn how to register an employee's departure: open their record, choose the departure reason and details, decide what happens to their leave and contract, and archive them.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to register an employee's departure: open their record, choose the departure reason and details, decide what happens to their leave and contract, and archive them.

steps.title: Open Employees
steps.description: Offboarding starts from the employee's record in the Employees app.

description_i18n.en_US: Offboarding starts from the employee's record in the Employees app.

steps.title: Open the employee
steps.content: Click the card of the employee who is leaving.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the card of the employee who is leaving.

steps.description: Each card is one employee. Open the card of the person whose departure you are registering.

description_i18n.en_US: Each card is one employee. Open the card of the person whose departure you are registering.

steps.title: Actions menu
steps.content: Click the gear icon to open the Actions menu.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the gear icon to open the Actions menu.

steps.description: The Actions menu holds the operations you can run on this record, such as archive, duplicate and delete.

description_i18n.en_US: The Actions menu holds the operations you can run on this record, such as archive, duplicate and delete.

steps.title: Archive
steps.description: Archiving is how Odoo registers a departure. The employee disappears from normal lists but their history is kept, so payslips and past records stay available.

description_i18n.en_US: Archiving is how Odoo registers a departure. The employee disappears from normal lists but their history is kept, so payslips and past records stay available.

steps.title: Departure reason
steps.content: Click the field and type the first letters of what you are looking for.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the field and type the first letters of what you are looking for.

steps.description: The reason, for example resignation or retirement, is kept on the record and used in HR reports. Typing narrows the list down; you pick the result in the next step.

description_i18n.en_US: The reason, for example resignation or retirement, is kept on the record and used in HR reports. Typing narrows the list down; you pick the result in the next step.

steps.validation_message: Type at least two letters of what you are looking for.

validation_message_i18n.en_US: Type at least two letters of what you are looking for.

steps.title: Choose the reason
steps.content: Click the result you want in the list.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the result you want in the list.

steps.description: Pick the reason that best describes the departure. It cannot be left empty.

description_i18n.en_US: Pick the reason that best describes the departure. It cannot be left empty.

steps.title: Detailed reason
steps.content: Type a short note about the departure, then click anywhere outside the box.

content_i18n.en_US: Type a short note about the departure, then click anywhere outside the box.

steps.description: Use this note to record details that the reason alone does not give, such as the agreed last working day or handover arrangements. The step finishes when you click outside the note box, so take your time to write it.

description_i18n.en_US: Use this note to record details that the reason alone does not give, such as the agreed last working day or handover arrangements. The step finishes when you click outside the note box, so take your time to write it.

steps.title: Departure date
steps.content: Click the date field to check the departure date.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the date field to check the departure date.

steps.description: The departure date is the employee's last day. It starts as today, so change it in the calendar if they leave on another day.

description_i18n.en_US: The departure date is the employee's last day. It starts as today, so change it in the calendar if they leave on another day.

steps.title: Apply
steps.content: Click Apply to register the departure.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Apply to register the departure.

steps.description: Apply archives the employee, records the reason and date, and applies the choices you made about leave and the contract.

description_i18n.en_US: Apply archives the employee, records the reason and date, and applies the choices you made about leave and the contract.

steps.title: Departure registered
steps.content: The employee is now archived. Click the name to finish.

content_i18n.en_US: The employee is now archived. Click the name to finish.

steps.description: An archived employee shows an Archived banner on their record. Nothing is deleted: you can still open the record and restore the employee later if needed.

description_i18n.en_US: An archived employee shows an Archived banner on their record. Nothing is deleted: you can still open the record and restore the employee later if needed.
